scope: Physical Android tablet; 360dp/412dp phone windows simulated through display overrides. Physical phones and a Windows machine without a globally installed runtime have not been tested.

checks: 360dp phone shows a full-height terminal list
Opening a phone terminal replaces the list
Phone navigation and send action remain visible
Soft keyboard was actually shown
Send button is visibly above the open keyboard
Sending with the soft keyboard open reaches the real Windows terminal
Draft survives resizing from 360dp to 412dp
Draft survives rotation to phone landscape
Draft survives phone landscape and return to portrait
Phone send reaches the real Windows terminal
Unsent text is not carried into another terminal
Returning to a terminal restores its own draft
Phone actions remain available at 130 percent font size
Tablet landscape shows list and detail together
Draft survives switching to the tablet layout
Tablet portrait keeps two panes when enough width is available
